description: [GA4 WRITE] Grant a user access to a GA4 property (needs analytics.manage.users scope). Requires GA4_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES=true and confirm=true.

confirm.description: Must be true to apply the change.

roles.description: Roles, e.g. ["predefinedRoles/viewer"], ["predefinedRoles/analyst"], ["predefinedRoles/editor"], ["predefinedRoles/admin"]. (GA4 uses viewer/analyst/editor/admin — not the legacy read/collaborate/edit/manage names.)

user.description: Email of the user to grant access to.

name: ga4_create_property_access_binding
